# sql-migration-lint

> Lint PostgreSQL migration files for operations that lock or rewrite tables or lose data, with line numbers, rule ids and suppressions. Python package `trysac-sql-migration-lint`, import name `sql_migration_lint`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
